entities.summary: Artyom Andreyevich Levshunov is a Belarusian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Chicago Blackhawks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He played college ice hockey for the Michigan State University. He was selected second overall by the Blackhawks in the 2024 NHL entry draft, the highest-drafted Belarusian player in NHL history, and made his NHL debut in 2025.
